(Stay Appl. No.77 of 2018) 
In 
CRLR No.12 of 2018 
Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
Mr. Niranjan Bhatt, Advocate for the 
revisionist. 
 Mr. Pawan Mishra, Advocate for the 
respondents. 
 Heard. 
 Admit. 
 Learned counsel for the revisionist 
submits that revisionist is present but the 
respondent no.1 is not present as she is ill. 
 Learned counsel for the parties 
submitted that parties will appear before 
this Court on 20.06.2018. 
 List this case on 20.06.2018. On that 
day noting their presence, they will be 
referred for mediation. 
 Also heard on stay application. 
 Considering the submission of 
learned counsel for parties, it is directed 
that till the next date of listing, operation 
and effect of the impugned judgment and 
order dated 14.12.2017 passed by the 
Judge, Family Court, Tehri Garhwal in 
Misc. Criminal Application No.45 of 2017 
(Old No.1 of 2017) Smt. Anita Rawat & 
others vs. Bijendra Singh Rawat shall 
remain stayed provided revisionist deposits 
`50,000/- to the respondent no.1 by way 
of bank draft. 
 Stay application stand disposed of. 
 
 (V.K. Bist, J.) 
 23.05.2018
Arti

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Lok Pal Singh
orders.text:
CRLR No.12 of 2018 
Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
Mr. Niranjan Bhatt, Advocate 
for the revisionist. 
Mr. Pawan Mishra, Advocate 
for the respondents. 
Heard learned counsel for the 
parties. 
Parties are present before this 
Court. A bank draft of Rs.50,000/- 
is handed over by the revisionist 
(husband) to the respondent no.1 
(wife). They are referred for 
mediation today itself. 
They shall appear before the 
In-charge, Mediation Center, who 
will submit his report after the 
mediation is over. In case, mediation 
is not concluded today, it will be 
open for the mediator to meet the 
parties in different sessions and 
fixed further dates also for 
mediation. 
List this matter on 27.6.2018 
along with the report of the 
mediator. 
Interim order dated 23.5.2018 
is extended till the next date of 
listing. 
 (V.K. Bist, J.) 
 20.6.2018 
A.kaur

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
CRLR No. 12 of 2018 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Niranjan Bhatt, Advocate for the 
revisionist. 
Mr. Pawan Mishra, Advocate for the 
respondent. 
Counter affidavit filed by the 
respondents is taken on record. 
Having heard the learned counsel for 
the parties on Stay Application No. 11405 of 
2018 and considering the fact that the wife 
has got two minor children with her to be 
maintained, the interim order granted by this 
Court on 23.05.2018 is modified to the extent 
that the revisionist would pay a sum of 
Rs.10,000/- p.m. to the wife tentatively during 
the pendency of the revision. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 12.12.2018 
Shiv
